# Build How-To: Heavy Energy Weapons / Heavy Gunner Energy Weapons in Power Armor

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_145_nukaknights-post-build-heavy-gunner-energy-pa.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This build specializes in **heavy energy weapons without explosive effects**. To get the most out of heavy weapons, this build plays in **Power Armor**. The “Stabilized” perk, which brings enormous advantages for heavy weapons, only works in PA. In fact, this **Build is playable both Bloodstained and Full Life**. In the full life version, the damage is slightly lower, but of course involves less risk. The choice of weapon is of course a little different. In the Full Life variant you rely on **double shot** instead of bloodstained. However, the damage is of course higher even with a double shot in the bloodstained variant (e.g. due to the adrenal reaction mutation).

## Equipment

![B2590 Gatling Plasma](/uploads/nukaknights-heavy-pa-energy-skywalka55-fallout76-20230420-11-20-33.jpg) 

![Bloodstained, +25% damage when you aim, 15% faster reload speed Ultrazit Gatling Laser](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20230410-22-51-50.jpg) 

![Bloodstained, +50% critical hit damage, 90% weight reduction plasma thrower](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20230410-22-50-40.jpg) 

![Quadruple body part damage 90% weight reduction pepper shaker (main purpose force Queen to land, damage/level is unimportant here)](/uploads/nukaknights-build-heavy-pa-peppershaker-skywalka55-fallout76-20230405-06-30-49.jpg) 

I mostly play the **Gatling Laser** on this build and larger opponents like the Queen, for example. the **Gatling Plasma**. The **plasma thrower** is very helpful at slightly greater distances. So I mainly need fusion cores and plasma cores here. I usually get enough **Plasma Cores** as loot from enemies, daily operations and events. **Fusion cores** can be handled easily with a few tricks. In the article Everything about Fusion Cores Farming & Charging I explained methods (also with videos) with which you can not only get new Fusion Cores, but also recharge old, almost empty or half-empty Fusion Cores. The “power absorption” perk is particularly helpful here. If you make sure to reload just before the core is empty when playing a Gatling Laser, you can use many cores almost infinitely. You simply recharge empty cores as described in the article. With this method I hardly lose any cores, in fact I usually lose more and more. With the perk “**Power User**” you also have double advantages. Your PA fusion core discharges half as fast and your **Gatling Laser** has 999 shots** per core, so twice as much before you have to reload. This is a big advantage over the Gatling Plasma.

The Gatling Laser always reminds me of the Final Judgment and the Aeternus from Fallout 4, which were some of my favorite weapons there. That's why I like playing him in Fallout 76. Although it may not be the most meta high-end weapon. I still like the handling and gameplay of the Gatling Laser.
